goal: Iske baad aap text file se numbers, words, lines aur poore records sahi loop ke saath parh sakenge, aur end-of-file ke mashhoor bug se bach sakenge.
warmup: Ek teacher marks sheet ke naam ek ke baad ek parhti jati hai jab tak sheet khatam na ho jaye. Woh har naam se pehle yeh nahi poochti "kya sheet khatam ho gayi?". Woh bas parhti rehti hai, aur jab parhne ko kuch na bache to ruk jati hai. Sahi file loop bhi aise hi kaam karta hai: parhne ki koshish karo, aur agar parhna kamyab ho gaya to value istemal karo.
definition: File parhne ke liye aap ifstream banate hain: ifstream in("data.txt");. File pehle se maujood honi chahiye. Operator >> cin >> ki tarah kaam karta hai: yeh spaces aur new lines chhod kar ek value (int, double ya word) parhta hai. getline(in, line) poori line ko, spaces samet, ek string mein parhta hai. Dono ko while loop ki condition bana sakte hain, kyunke jab parhna fail ho jaye (file khatam ho gayi, ya data ki qisam galat ho) to stream false ho jata hai. Is liye while (in >> x) ka matlab hai "jab tak value kamyabi se parhi ja rahi hai, chalte raho" aur while (getline(in, line)) ka matlab hai "jab tak line kamyabi se parhi ja rahi hai, chalte raho".
howItWorks: Pehla trace follow karein. Loop ki condition khud hi parhne ka kaam karti hai. Jab file khatam ho jati hai to read fail ho jata hai, condition false ho jati hai aur loop ruk jata hai. Kuch bhi do baar process nahi hota. Ab is bug se compare karein: while (!in.eof()). Flag eof tab true hota hai jab read pehle hi fail ho chuka hota hai, is liye body ek extra dafa purani ya bekaar value ke saath chal jati hai. Isi liye notes kehte hain: read ko condition mein rakhein. Records ke liye saari fields ek hi condition mein parhein: while (in >> roll >> name >> marks). Yeh tab kaam karta hai jab har record mein same fields, same tarteeb mein hon aur spaces se alag hon. Jab values spaces se alag hon to >> use karein. Jab poori line chahiye ho, masalan lines ginni hon ya aisa text parhna ho jis mein spaces hon, to getline use karein. Words ginne ke liye >> se string mein parhein: har >> ek word le leta hai. Tamam samples mein program pehle apni input file khud banata hai, taake yeh har jagah ek jaisa chale.
